_comment: Known-unresolved Mongolian bichig/Poppe categories (see minicloze_mongolian_poppe_audit.md §3, §8). Any token matching one of these is marked verified:false by scripts/mongolian_bichig.mjs even if a dictionary string happens to match, unless a sourced row in mongolian_bichig_overrides.json covers it. These rows only FLAG words; they never change bichig, Poppe or gloss. Resolve a word by adding a sourced override row, then remove it from here if listed.

reasons.past-laa: Past tense -лаа/-лоо/-лээ/-лөө. The converter often parses it as noun + reflexive (гарлаа γarul-iyan, уулаа aγula-ban). The target convention (-l-a/-l-e vs -luγ-a/-laγ-a) is undecided.
reasons.tai-detached: Adjectival -тай/-тэй/-той/-төй written detached with MVS. Adjectives are usually written attached (хэрэгтэй keregtei), true comitatives detached; each word needs a reader's decision.
reasons.du-ban: Dative + reflexive written -du-ban/-tü-ben; the expected form is -daγan/-degen. Rule not yet confirmed per word.
reasons.guess-tier: Converter rule-fallback ('guess' tier, about 6% reliable per its README) and not matched by any dictionary.
reasons.homograph: Homograph resolved without sentence context; the chosen reading may be the wrong word.
reasons.gloss-error: The English gloss in the explanation is wrong for this sentence. The bichig/Poppe shown are believed right for the sentence but the token is flagged until the gloss is fixed.
reasons.poppe-rule-mismatch: Bichig is dictionary-checked but the Poppe string is not the rule-based (vowel-harmony) transliteration of that bichig.
reasons.not-dictionary-checked: Machine output from @gege-mn/gege-converter 0.5.0 (a candidate generator) not matched against mongoltoli.mn or Wiktionary and not covered by a sourced override.

homographs.note: Glossed 'blue' (e.g. -100022) and 'breast' (e.g. -500264); the converter gives the same reading köke for both senses. mongoltoli.mn only returned the first headword ('blue').
Glossed 'at the beginning', but the data has the reading eke-dü ('to the mother'); sentence audit -101401.
Flagged in sentence audit -101401 (month vs moon reading chosen without context).
Glossed 'television'; data reading ǰiruγtu. Marked ambiguous in the sentence audit (-100955); not confirmed by a dictionary.

gloss_errors.note: 'Энэ хоол хоёр хүнд хангалттай': хүнд is the dative of хүн 'person', not 'heavy'. Bichig ᠬᠦᠮᠦᠨ᠎ᠳᠦ kümün-dü is kept; the explanation gloss 'heavy' is wrong and needs fixing in the corpus explanations.
